notes.title: Update v.230775
notes.content:
Friends!

We are glad to inform you about our innovations:


1. We launched a new system for calculating and storing a rating, and a new principle for rating tables.

Now the game has 2 rating tables - rating by month and year.
At the beginning of each month (starting from February 1), all players will be assigned a base rating equal to 1000. At the end of the month, the leaders of the rating (first five) will receive a reward for a successful month of combat, after which a new stage will begin and the rating of all players will again be equal to 1000 etc.
We remind you that raising / lowering the rating for victories in battles takes place according to the Elo system.

At the end of the year, 5 leaders of the annual rating will receive an award, which we will tell about later.

2. Added new conditions for the end of the battle: if a player or an opponent has all his cards destroyed, then he loses.

3. Fixed user data errors when starting the game on different PCs.

4. Player’s personal file now displays correct data.

All changes will take effect when you enter the new version of the game, all data on combat statistics will be reset, the rating will start, and statistics on the month and year will begin.

notes.content:
Hello, friends!

In the last update there was a division into two game modes:
 
1. Basic. This is a battle with a random opponent.

notes.title: Guide to the game
notes.content:
Dear friends!

With you the rubric "Guide to the game" and today we will talk about cards.

There are several types of cards in the game, we will describe each of them in detail in the following posts. Now let's talk about common characteristics and attributes.

To the characteristics, which, as a rule, everyone understands, we can relate:

- cost- the amount of initiative that is spent when to play a card.
- damage -damage inflicted to the enemy during attack and counterattack.
- defense- the amount of damage that can withstand the card.

More questions are usually caused by badges on the cards:

1. Type of troops.
This icon displays the card's belonging to Infantry or Machinery.
Please note that the card's abilities may have specialization in this parameter. Also, operations cards can act differently on different types of troops.

2. Card landing zones.
Contain information about which areas of the battlefield the card can be played.
We recommend that this indicator be taken into account when drawing up their decks, and also to protect the landing zones of their troops.

3. Special abilities of the card.
Show what additional abilities the card has.
Clicking on the card with the right mouse button, you will see a full description of the ability.

We hope that this information will help you to create your winning deck!

notes.title: Guide to the game
notes.content:
Good day, friends!

On air, the rubric "Guide to the game" and today we continue our story about the battlefield.

On the field, we fall right after choosing an opponent.
Next, players need to determine who will be the first to go. The player and his opponent choose one card, on each card the number is from 1 to 5. To whom the card with the largest number falls, he goes first.

The game is provided with 25 cards, 5 of them are already in the player's hand.
Few people know, but for a better view of the battlefield, the cards in the hand can be hidden (by pressing the triangle, the hand with the cards is lowered).

The following elements are marked in the figures:

1. Decks, for them we can understand how many more cards the opponent has left, but we must take into account that he can also have a strong card in his hand.

2.Points of the initiative, which are used to draw cards. In the first turn, players receive 5 units each, in the subsequent 5 + n, where n is the number of moves. We advise you to be careful when collecting decks: many newcomers are collecting expensive heavy cards and as a result they can not make the first move, as they lack initiative points. And in the game there are maps with abilities that allow you to steal the initiative of the enemy or just get an additional initiative, we recommend to take into account this fact.

3.Discard cards player and his opponent.

4. Opponent turn button. It has a timer indicator, the turn is given for 2 minutes and after their expiration all indicators go out.

The battlefield is divided into different strategic areas: front, flanks, rear, neutral line (for a big field)
Different cards have different landing zones, but many players believe that this is unnecessary.
Experienced soldiers who learned to calculate the strategy at the expense of these mechanics, categorically opposed to allowing the cards to land at any point in front of the headquarters. And for beginners, it would help to sort out the game faster.
At the moment this issue is in discussion. Therefore, if you have your own vision of this situation, we will be happy to hear your opinion!

notes.title: Guide to the game
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

Very often we tell you only about updates, but we do not talk much about the game itself. It's time to fix it! :) We launch the weekly "Guide to the game", in which we will tell newcomers and remind the old-timers the basics and secrets of our game.

Let's start with the basics. Today we will tell you about the battlefield. There are two types of battlefields in the game: big and small.

The strategy of the game and the selection of effective decks on them is quite different. The best combat techniques in these fields will be described later.

At the moment, most players choose a big field and build their decks and strategies only for this type of game.

Choosing the field, we see the scene of the selection of the battle. It allows players to create their own game rooms, as well as connect to those rooms that have already been created.

And we also have a bot, our famous Petrovich! But, since most often it is very, very drunk, it is rather weak and is calculated more likely for people who never played such games. Although this does not prevent many players from testing on it the techniques of their decks.

It is impossible not to mention the search for a battle. He selects the opponent in accordance with the values in the global rating table. But if there is no suitable opponent, then there is a connection to who is online and is looking for a battle.

Often new recruits get into a fight with old-timers, which leads newcomers to frustration and a negative perception of reality :)))
Dear newcomers! Do not be sad if you lost to the players from the top ten or even hundreds of the rating table, they are experienced players! The best advice is to remember their strategy and deck, and try to play in the same style. You can collect a killer deck and defeat any experienced player!

We hope that this information was useful to you! Thank you for attention! If something remains that you do not understand, write your questions, we will necessarily answer them :)

Friends!
We did not share news with you for a long time, because most of the work took place in a special version of the game and was visible only to a small number of testers who agreed to help us with the adjustment. Separate them for this thank you!
During this time, many things have changed, rather complicated organizational issues have been resolved, which hampered the work on the game. At some point, it was impossible to play.
BUT! We were able not only to withstand the onslaught of problems, but also continued to work on the game all this time!
Below we have collected all the innovations and improvements that have been made since the publication of the last major update. All this can already be seen in the game!

So:
- Introduced the rating system Elo, the global rating table.
- A collection of cards, in it you can see the current collection of player cards, as well as all possible cards in the game. Later, the card parsing function will be launched.
- Added rarity indicators on the maps. More details about the rarity will be written later in a separate post.
- Tablet-menu: opens after a click 
- Control of disconnect of the opponent: if someone disconnects, then loses.
-Multiple rework of the network mode of the game.
-New type of lighting. When highlighted for attack, the card is highlighted in yellow. If the card can only attack, then orange.  A card that is waiting for a target to be selected for its special opportunity is highlighted in purple.

notes.title: BE ruthless with this CREEP
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25915672/368477bbf419a2d52b8899885ace44e602271f0d.png[/img]

As many of you know in our game was a pretty famous (among the players) bug. He was like a virus from day one in our game and showed up in any moment on the whole screen and was look like childish mountebanks of acid color.

Long time we couldn't catch him, but finally we did it. Of course we could just say to you that we found and destroyed him, but we thought that it isn't enough and this specific bug deserves a bit more attention. We've honored him and even draw a picture in his honor.

As some called him "acid-psychological warfare" is no longer exists, we've killed this thug!

notes.title: Еще карты!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25915672/839e7326b896be8c88617f879d37ced009d7020f.jpg[/img]

А вот и ещё пехотки подвалило. 

Опять особой, а не простой. Посему по характеристикам довольно отличной.

Собственно за СССР у нас Тяжёлая ШИСБР. Вчера мы рассказали вам просто о юните с названием "ШИСБР", а это более тяжелая и опытная версия, которая по предназначению является штурмовым отрядом. Здесь очень важны перки. Последние два вам уже знакомы по вчерашнему обзору, а вот перк "Ручная Работа" заслуживает отдельного внимания.

"Ручная работа" - активный перк, имеющий перезарядку в 2 хода и позволяющий при активации с 80% вероятностью уничтожить танк противника.

А у Германии у нас в главной роли выступают Штурмовые Пионеры.
У этих парней всего 2 способности, но при этом их базовая возможность бронебойности позволяет эффективно уничтожать лёгкую бронетехнику. А дополнительный перк "Рывок", имеющий перезарядку в 2 хода, позволяет сделать ход на 2 клетки и при этом нанести удар противнику.

Вот такие вот интересные юниты у нас получились.

Initially, we decided to call them "units supply" (in-game currency, silver equivalent) and "Cash" (donate currency, analogue of gold), but from the past, we decided to give up, as it sounds a little trite and typical.

Instead of "Cash", donate currency, our game will be "Time unit" as "time - money" and vice versa. Everything takes time. Time spent on the repair of equipment, the time spent on the delivery of ammunition and security. The time necessary for the delivery of reinforcements, and where you do not look, time, here it is the same invisible resource that whenever and wherever needed, and that always lacks. Everybody says that time can not be bought! Well, in this game it will be possible!
